responsibility: Provides the x86 AMX-TRANSPOSE intrinsic header for tile transposition, transpose-oriented tile memory loads, and transpose-aware matrix arithmetic. Besides the base `ttransposed` and `t2rpntlvwz*` load forms, it temporarily enables related AMX subfeatures and exposes the transpose-specific BF16, FP16, complex-FP16, and TF32 tile multiply helpers such as `_tile_tdpbf16ps`, `_tile_tdpfp16ps`, `_tile_tcmm*`, and `_tile_tmmultf32ps`, making this the AMX header dedicated to transpose-mode tile operations rather than generic tile control.
